description: One run writes data/runs/<UTC>/. The global fee ledger is data/spend.json and is not reset when a new run directory is created. Dry-run signatures are not appended to that ledger. Judges re-fetch a slot with getBlock(slot, {encoding: jsonParsed, maxSupportedTransactionVersion: 1, transactionDetails: full, rewards: false, commitment: confirmed}) and match signatures from attempts.jsonl. Our probes have no memo.

files.manifest.json: mode, git sha, cap, redacted RPC, Alpenglow cutoff slot, genesis certificate, CU limit, QUIC warmup slots, burst offset slots, permutation seed, transaction format, ladder rungs
files.validators.json: identity, vote account, software client, version, stake, jito, tpu, classification source
files.spend.json: this run's planned fees, principal, and whether they were counted against the cap
files.attempts.jsonl: one object per transaction: signature, leader, ladder, fee, cu limit, cu price, priority score, send index, target slot, tpu host and port, landed slot, block index, submitted
files.blocks/<slot>.json: raw getBlock response used to assign indexes. Empty until a collect after a live send.
files.run.log: stdout copy of the run summary
files.data/spend.json: global lamports signed across runs. Survives a container restart.
